parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response.

Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member in Cloud Firewall.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-ips-whitelist --lang zh --member-uid 1766180000104675 --vpc-firewall-id cen-000 --region cn-hangzhou
